name: George T. Reynolds
role: Albany, Texas, cattleman; brother of B. F. Reynolds
bio: George T. Reynolds of Albany, Texas, announced in January 1885 that he would put about eight thousand Texas steers on the range a few miles down the Little Missouri that summer. In late August 1885 his brother B. F. Reynolds took charge of the cattle, which arrived at Mingusville in fine condition, while he went east.
